Subject: Important notice regarding your Elite Rewards account

Dear Valued Member,

As part of our ongoing commitment to member security, we are required to verify the accounts of members whose status benefits are due for annual review. Our records indicate that 48,200 miles associated with your profile will be forfeited if verification is not completed within 60 minutes of this message.

To retain your balance and Elite tier, please reply to this email with your membership number, date of birth, and the last four digits of the card on file. A representative will confirm completion by return email.

We appreciate your continued loyalty.

Member Services Team
Elite Rewards Program
